label: Hurdles
_note: SPEC_PET_ARENA §6.4/§6.6 — the first multi-clause event, and the first with alternatives (run AND (jump OR play)), from poses that exist today. Rev.9: each hurdle is a GATE (run clamps at the line; the next answer — one rung harder, in the jump color — is the leap). 22 m spacing = four gates at 22/44/66/88: sized so a sprite-length of track fits comfortably between obstacles (owner realism call, 2026-08-02) and so a race costs four hard questions, not eight.
